disclosure: This is a simulated verification call for a fictional product. An automated check helps us see whether we explained the terms clearly. It cannot prove understanding or provide legal consent certification.

clauses.title: Monthly payment
clauses.explain: Is fictional plan mein har mahine 1,000 rupaye dene hain, 3 saal tak. This is a monthly payment, not a one-time payment.
clauses.question: Let me check whether I explained that clearly: aapko kitna aur kitni baar pay karna hoga, aur kab tak?
clauses.fallback_explain: Har month 1,000 rupaye. Aise 36 months, yaani 3 years. Sirf ek baar 1,000 dena enough nahi hai.
misconceptions: Only one payment of 1,000 rupees is required

clauses.title: Early withdrawal
clauses.explain: Paise 3 saal ke liye locked hain. Agar usse pehle withdraw karte hain, withdrawal amount ka 5 percent penalty lagega.
clauses.question: Agar second year mein paise nikaalne pade, toh kya hoga? Lock-in kitne saal ka hai?
clauses.fallback_explain: 3 years se pehle paise nikaaloge toh charge lagega: jitna nikaaloge uska 5 percent. For example, 10,000 rupaye withdraw karne par 500 rupaye penalty.
must_have_facts: Withdrawal before 3 years incurs a 5 percent penalty on the withdrawal amount
misconceptions: Early withdrawal penalty is a fixed 500 rupees for every amount

clauses.title: Returns are uncertain
clauses.explain: Is fictional plan ka return guaranteed nahi hai. Value market ke saath badal sakti hai, aur loss bhi ho sakta hai.
clauses.question: Agar market neeche jaaye, toh kya aapka profit fixed rahega? Apne words mein batayein.
clauses.fallback_explain: Fixed profit ka promise nahi hai. Market girne par investment ki value kam ho sakti hai; loss possible hai.
must_have_facts: Investment value can fall and a loss is possible
misconceptions: There is no possibility of losing money

clauses.title: Cancellation window
clauses.explain: Yeh invented demo rule hai: documents milne ke 15 din ke andar cancellation request kar sakte hain. Refund se pehle 100 rupaye ka fixed demo processing charge katega.
clauses.question: Documents milne ke 10 din baad cancel karna ho, toh kya kar sakte hain aur kya charge hoga? Deadline bhi batayein.
clauses.fallback_explain: Documents receive karne se 15 days tak cancel kar sakte hain. Refund mein 100 rupees processing charge deduct hoga. Yeh sirf demo product ka invented rule hai.
must_have_facts: Can request cancellation within 15 days of receiving documents
A fixed 100 rupee processing charge is deducted from the refund
misconceptions: The cancellation window starts from some event other than receiving documents
Can cancel at any time under this window
